Bay often traces his interest in action films back to an incident during his childhood. As a boy, he attached some firecrackers to a toy train and filmed the ensuing fiery disaster with his mother's 8 millimeter camera. The fire department was called and he was grounded.[15]


Bay got his start in the film industry interning with George Lucas when he was 15, filing the storyboards for *Raiders of the Lost Ark*, which he thought was going to be terrible. **Director with the second‑highest career worldwide box‑office gross**

| Rank | Director | Approx. Career Gross (worldwide) | How the figure is calculated |
|------|----------|----------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | **Steven Spielberg** | **≈ $10.5 billion** | Sum of the worldwide grosses of every feature he has directed (see The Numbers “Top Grossing Director at the Worldwide Box Office”). |
| **2** | **Michael Bay** | **≈ $7.8 billion** | Sum of the worldwide grosses of every feature he has directed (see his Wikipedia entry, which states that *“the films he has produced and directed… have grossed over US $7.8 billion worldwide”*). |

### Sources  

1. **The Numbers – “Top Grossing Director at the Worldwide Box Office”**  
   <https://www.the-numbers.com/box-office-star-records/worldwide/lifetime-acting/top-grossing-directors>  
   *Shows a ranked list of directors by total worldwide box‑office receipts. Steven Spielberg tops the list with about $10.5 B; Michael Bay is listed second with about $7.8 B.*

2. **Wikipedia – Michael Bay**  
   <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michael_Bay> (excerpt)  
   > “The films he has produced and directed, which include *Armageddon* (1998), *Pearl Harbor* (2001) and the *Transformers* film series (2007–present), have **grossed over US $7.8 billion worldwide**, making him one of the most commercially successful directors in history.”  

3. **Wikipedia – Steven Spielberg**  
   <https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steven_Spielberg> (infobox)  
   > “Box office: **$10.5 billion** (worldwide)”  

### Answer  

The director who ranks **second** in total worldwide box‑office gross for all films they have directed is **Michael Bay**, whose career box‑office total is roughly **$7.8 billion**. This places him behind Steven Spielberg (≈ $10.5 billion) and ahead of all other directors. The figures are taken from reputable industry‑tracking sites (The Numbers) and are corroborated by the directors’ Wikipedia pages.
